headline: Ramon Ang Cites Tulaoc Bridge Debris as Factor in NLEX Flooding
seoTitle: Ramon Ang Cites Debris in NLEX Flooding | FMB News
seoDescription: SMC president Ramon Ang said soil and debris left from 2024 Tulaoc Bridge works obstructed water flow and contributed to NLEX flooding in San Simon, Pampanga.
deck: MPTC also pointed to a broader drainage problem and extreme water volume, making the flooding a multi-factor infrastructure issue.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: San Miguel Corp. president Ramon Ang said soil and debris left after the 2024 repair of the NLEX Tulaoc Bridge obstructed water flow and contributed to severe flooding along the expressway in San Simon, Pampanga.
The flooding caused hours-long traffic congestion during the prolonged monsoon rains.

sections.heading: Other factors cited
paragraphs: NLEX operator MPTC said the flooding also reflected a broader drainage problem in Pampanga. It cited saturated downstream communities and the large volume of monsoon water that could not readily drain toward Manila Bay.

sections.heading: Response
paragraphs: Ang offered heavy equipment to help clear obstructions, while MPTC coordinated with transport and public-works agencies on flood-mitigation measures and planned elevation work around the Tulaoc section.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The competing explanations show why recurrent expressway flooding needs a system-level drainage assessment rather than a single-cause narrative.
